people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and shalt wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
